candidate.selection: B preferred for experiment, not proven
candidate.description: Trusted Jackin control remains outside workloads; use a separate OpenShell sandbox for each account/security domain and a separate shell domain. Jackin keeps logical instance/session UX, authorization, provider usage logic, and host desktop actions.
unresolved: coherent logical instance over multiple sandbox identities
Capsule single-multiplexer semantics across per-domain sandboxes: persistent session identity, focus/control ownership, event history, PTY resize/signal, disconnect/reconnect
candidate.challenge: One Capsule multiplexer currently owns a shared local session table, focus/tabs, PTY children and attach socket. Candidate B moves those to multiple remote sandboxes; OpenShell process streams must be proven to reconnect to a running child and preserve stable session identity. Minimum POC: two deterministic PTYs plus one actual supported agent in two account sandboxes and a separate shell sandbox; disconnect/reconnect, focus/send/take/release, resize, interrupt one while verifying the other remains alive, restart one sandbox, preserve private homes and share only project data. If unavailable, requires a small Jackin session adaptation or supported OpenShell persistent-session API. NOT TESTED.

agents.source_note: The enum has 12 agents. runtime_setup/agents.rs has setup/state handlers beyond the launch dispatcher. docker/runtime/entrypoint.sh remains unchanged at 6e and only dispatches initial and sibling PTY child launch for Claude, Codex, Amp, Kimi, OpenCode, Grok. Call chain: argv::resolve_initial_agent -> attach_protocol::initial_spawn_requests (initial plus configured siblings) -> daemon/session_lifecycle::spawn -> agent_spawn::spawn_session -> session/agent_cmd::build_agent_command -> /runtime/entrypoint.sh with JACKIN_AGENT. Six-agent launch limitation remains. Role admission, image installation, and each agent authentication path still require tracing/proof.

launch_dispatch.initial: docker/runtime/entrypoint.sh supports Claude, Codex, Amp, Kimi, OpenCode, Grok only
launch_dispatch.siblings: argv::resolve_initial_agent -> attach_protocol::initial_spawn_requests -> daemon/run_loop -> daemon/session_lifecycle/spawn -> agent_spawn::spawn_session -> session/agent_cmd::build_agent_command -> /runtime/entrypoint.sh with JACKIN_AGENT; same six-case dispatch applies
launch_dispatch.setup_note: runtime_setup/agents.rs extra state/setup handlers do not establish executable launch support
launch_dispatch.status: Six-agent launch limitation remains at pinned 6e; join role admission and image installation before declaring any one supported end-to-end

classification_notes: Source and unit tests are not runtime proof.
Host clipboard, URL, reveal, and export remain Jackin host responsibilities.
Admission/revision checks do not imply immediate termination/revocation of active connections.
Current Jackin 6e differs significantly from historical 41bad Capsule; Darwin reaper only applies when Capsule process runs on macOS.
Source tests and code paths establish intended behavior only; all Capsule call-site rows are runtime untested unless explicitly supported by separate applicable execution evidence.

changed_behavior: PID1 reaper implementation and tests expanded
main.rs prepares/activates Darwin reaper when Capsule process target is macOS
daemon/boot.rs requires active Darwin reaper on macOS and installs SIGCHLD reaper on non-macOS
session/spawn.rs registers child ownership before/after PTY spawn and transfers uncertain wait outcomes to reaper
util.rs and pr_context.rs change child polling and handle drop/wait ordering
version_diff_41bad_to_6e.compatibility: Historical runtime evidence on changed Capsule child lifecycle, spawn/wait, or reaper paths must be rerun. Source findings on unchanged entrypoint/setup files remain applicable. Darwin-specific behavior only runs when Capsule process itself is macOS; macOS host plus Linux guest is not Darwin execution.
